mechanism: Sodium valproate inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase valbenazine exposure; both drugs have CNS effects and valproate can potentiate sedation/CNS depression.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine adverse effects (sedation, akathisia, tardive dyskinesia); consider dose adjustment of valbenazine if CNS symptoms emerge; therapeutic drug monitoring of valproate levels may be warranted.
